newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Fujitsu Australia appoints Neville Roach as CEO.
newsitem.headline: Fujitsu Australia appoints Neville Roach as CEO.

text.p: Japan-based electronics, computer and telecommunications giant Fujitsu Ltd said on Monday Neville Roach had been appointed chairman and chief executive officer of its 80 percent owned Fujitsu Australia.
Roach is currently managing director of the Australian unit. The U.K.-based International Computers holds the other 20 percent of Fujitsu Australia.

Other new directors appointed are Naoyuki Akikusa and Atsuyuki Kodama from Fujitsu Ltd, Bryan Daniels, Fujitsu Australia's executive director of information systems and Doug Dent, managing director of FBA Computer Technology Services.
